instruction: List all of the romance books released in 2023, that were in the top 10 most sold fiction books in Canada by print sales volume, and who appeared on the New York Times "Combined Print & E-Book Fiction" list for more than 20 consecutive weeks in the same year.
answer:

1. *It Starts with Us* – Colleen Hoover
2. *It Ends with Us* – Colleen Hoover
3. *Fourth Wing* – Rebecca Yarros
4. *Homecoming* – Kate Morton
5. *The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo* – Taylor Jenkins Reid
6. *Icebreaker* – Hannah Grace
7. *Lessons in Chemistry* – Bonnie Garmus
8. *Verity* – Colleen Hoover
9. *Iron Flame* – Rebecca Yarros
10. *Meet Me at the Lake* – Carley Fortune

## Romance books from that list that also spent **20+ consecutive weeks on the NYT "Combined Print & E-Book Fiction" list in 2023**:

| Book | Author | Canada Rank | NYT Combined List Weeks in 2023 |
|------|--------|-------------|----------------------------------|
| **It Starts with Us** | Colleen Hoover | #1 | 34+ weeks (13 weeks by Feb 19, 34 weeks by Jun 25) |
| **It Ends with Us** | Colleen Hoover | #2 | 52+ weeks (86 cumulative by Feb 19, on list all year) |
| **Fourth Wing** | Rebecca Yarros | #3 | 30+ weeks (debuted May 2023, on list continuously through Dec) |
| **Verity** | Colleen Hoover | #8 | 52+ weeks (86 cumulative by Feb 19, on list all year) |

## Not qualifying:
- **The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo** (#5 Canada) – Historical romance; appeared on NYT combined list but current streak shown as only 10 weeks in July 2023 (cumulative 115+ weeks mostly pre-2023)
- **Icebreaker** (#6 Canada) – Only 5 weeks on combined list by July 2023
- **Iron Flame** (#9 Canada) – Released Nov 2023; only ~7-8 weeks in 2023
- **Meet Me at the Lake** (#10 Canada) – No evidence of NYT combined list placement
- **Homecoming** & **Lessons in Chemistry** – Not primarily romance
